  WHY: When preparing the resolver prompt, this Python one-liner imports os and sys. If the PR checkout contains malicious os.py or sys.py modules at the root, they would be imported instead of the standard library, executing attacker code before the resolver sandbox starts.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1267 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The resolver retry prompt prelude expansion executes `python3 -c "import os,re,sys; ..."` in the PR checkout without PYTHONSAFEPATH=1. This runs during conflict resolution retry attempts with credentials available.
  WHY: When building retry prompts after resolver failures, this Python one-liner imports os, re, and sys. If the PR checkout contains malicious modules at the root, they would be imported instead of the standard library, executing attacker code in the host environment.
